text: The codebase is executing a coordinated three-reform "clean-break" redesign (ADR spine 0069–0073) across all targets simultaneously: kill `register_defaults()`, retire raw interest/feed C ABI in favor of typed sessions, and classify publish routes with explicit pre-sign provenance. Each reform is being applied to native, browser, and starter targets in rapid succession with doctrine-lint ratchets closing the door behind each completed slice — the pattern is "ship the right thing, then lock it." Orthogonally, zap/NIP-57 was cleanly excised from v1 scope, and display-separation (no tint/display logic in kernel projections) continues to be actively enforced. The overall trajectory is toward a leaner, fully typed, explicitly composed FFI surface ready for UniFFI-native direction. [...] Everything active traces to one north-star epic.
